author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. 'Parametrized across EVERY channel so a new one cannot quietly fall outside the guarantee' is literally implemented: @pytest.mark.parametrize('channel', CHANNELS) - the parameter list IS metadata.CHANNELS, so adding a seventh channel extends the guarantee automatically rather than leaving it behind. That is the derive-don't-restate rule applied to a test's own coverage.
